summary: Gran Tierra Energy filed an 8-K reporting the October 9, 2026 special meeting at which stockholders approved the Share Sale and Purchase Agreement with Maurel Prom Andina S.A.S. and Établissements Maurel et Prom S.A., covering the sale of substantially all assets under Delaware Section 271. Holders of 19,351,115 shares voted for the Sale Proposal versus 32,492 against and 7,328 abstaining; turnout was 54.81% of 35,380,429 shares outstanding as of the September 14 record date. A separate advisory golden-parachute proposal failed (9,557,007 for, 9,658,068 against). Watch closing conditions and regulatory clearances.
